answer: Eigentrust with seed anchoring resists sybils: global trust is the principal eigenvector of the normalized vouch matrix, pinned to a pre-trusted seed vault so the ranking cannot detach from honest ground truth. A terrace of sybils forming a tight internal block becomes its own eigen-cluster, but anchoring forces the dominant vector to weight the seed vault — the ember of real trust — so the detached block's self-reinforcing mass converges to near-zero global score. Internal mutual-vouching inflates local rank but cannot move the seed-anchored global eigenvector.
